title: Pure Chaos
summary: Pure Chaos strategy focusing on banishing LIGHT and DARK monsters from hand and GY to summon iconic powerhouses and modern Chaos Synchros, supported by Dragon extenders and staple Spells. Shell of Chaos and Core of Chaos provide resilient Tuner and non-Tuner bodies that recur when banished, fueling high-impact Synchro summons and relentless banish removal.

summary.title: Starters
points: Chaos Space discards a LIGHT or DARK monster to search an opposite-Attribute monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, then banishes itself from the GY to recycle a banished monster and draw a card.
Core of Chaos banishes a DARK monster from hand or GY to Special Summon itself as a Level 2 LIGHT Tuner, and Special Summons a banished Shell of Chaos when banished.
Shell of Chaos banishes a LIGHT monster from hand or GY to Special Summon itself as a Level 4 DARK non-Tuner, and Special Summons a banished Core of Chaos when banished.
White Dragon Wyverburster and Black Dragon Collapserpent banish opposite Attributes from the GY to Special Summon themselves and search each other upon leaving the field.

summary.title: Opening: Chaos Space + DARK Monster
steps: Activate Chaos Space, discarding a DARK monster to search White Dragon Wyverburster from your Deck.
Special Summon White Dragon Wyverburster by banishing the discarded DARK monster from your GY.
Normal Summon Core of Chaos (or use its effect by banishing a DARK monster).
Synchro Summon Chaos Beast using Level 2 Tuner Core of Chaos and Level 4 Wyverburster.
Trigger Wyverburster in the GY to add Black Dragon Collapserpent to hand, and trigger Chaos Beast to recover a banished LIGHT or DARK monster back to your hand.
Special Summon Collapserpent by banishing Wyverburster, and banish Chaos Space from your GY to place a banished monster on the bottom of the Deck and draw 1 card.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Chaos Angel is a Level 10 Synchro that can treat any LIGHT or DARK monster as a Tuner; summoned with LIGHT, it protects your monsters from monster effects; with DARK, it protects your monsters from battle; on summon, it banishes any card on the field.
Chaos Archfiend gains 2000 ATK when a card is banished, can attack all opponent monsters in sequence, and banishes any monster it destroys by battle.
The Chaos Creator banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK from the GY to summon itself, then targets 3 banished monsters to Special Summon 1 and shuffle the other 2 into the Deck.
Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning banishes an opponent's monster on field or attacks a second time in a row upon destroying a monster.
Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End sends all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the GY, inflicting 300 damage for each card sent.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Allure of Darkness draws 2 cards and banishes a DARK monster, triggering the banish effects of Core of Chaos or Chaos Valkyria.
Chaos Zone accumulates Chaos Counters whenever monsters are banished, removing counters to revive banished monsters of matching Levels.
Chaos Phantasm shuffles a banished LIGHT Warrior and DARK Fiend into the Deck to Special Summon a Chaos Synchro directly from the Extra Deck.
Chaos Valkyria mills a LIGHT or DARK monster from the Deck when banished, precisely setting up follow-up banish targets or revivals.

allow.White Dragon Wyverburster: Banishes a DARK monster from GY to Special Summon itself and searches Collapserpent when sent to the GY.
allow.Black Dragon Collapserpent: Banishes a LIGHT monster from GY to Special Summon itself and searches Wyverburster when sent to the GY.
allow.Allure of Darkness: Draws 2 cards and banishes a DARK monster from hand, triggering banished recursion effects.

main: The Chaos Creator
Banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK from GY to Special Summon itself; Special Summons 1 banished monster and returns 2 others to the Deck.
Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
Iconic Chaos boss that banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK from GY to summon itself and either banishes a monster or attacks twice.
Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
Banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK to summon itself and pays 1000 LP to send all Chaos cards to the GY and burn.
Chaos Valkyria
Special Summons itself by banishing 1 LIGHT or DARK from GY and dumps a LIGHT or DARK monster from the Deck when banished.
Chaos Nephthys
Special Summons itself from hand or GY when a card on the field is destroyed by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK, then banishes 1 field card and 2 GY cards.
Chaos Mirage Dragon
Level 4 LIGHT Wyrm Tuner that Special Summons a banished LIGHT or DARK monster and banishes opposing monsters when used for a Synchro Summon.
Chaos Daedalus
Grants targeting protection to LIGHT and DARK monsters and banishes cards on the field while a Field Spell is face-up.
Core of Chaos
Level 2 LIGHT Tuner that banishes 1 DARK monster from hand/GY to Special Summon itself and recurs when banished.
Shell of Chaos
Level 4 DARK non-Tuner that banishes 1 LIGHT monster from hand/GY to Special Summon itself and recurs when banished.
White Dragon Wyverburster
LIGHT Chaos Dragon starter that searches Black Dragon Collapserpent.
Black Dragon Collapserpent
DARK Chaos Dragon extender that searches White Dragon Wyverburster.
Chaos Space
Discards a LIGHT or DARK monster to search any Level 4-8 LIGHT or DARK monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, then recycles a banished monster to draw 1.
Chaos Zone
Field Spell that gains counters when monsters are banished to Special Summon a banished monster.
Chaos Phantasm
Trap that returns 1 banished LIGHT Warrior and 1 DARK Fiend to the Deck to summon a Chaos Synchro from the Extra Deck.
Allure of Darkness
Draws 2 cards and banishes Core of Chaos or Chaos Valkyria from hand to trigger their effects.
extra: Level 10 Synchro that treats any LIGHT or DARK monster as a Tuner, banishes a card on Summon, and grants battle/monster effect protection.
Level 8 Synchro that gains 2000 ATK when cards are banished, attacks all opposing monsters, and banishes any monster it destroys.
Level 6 Synchro that recovers a banished LIGHT or DARK monster every turn and revives itself from the GY.
Classic Level 8 Chaos Synchro that discards a LIGHT monster to revive a Level 5 or higher DARK monster from the GY.
